about.title: Who is Ghst
paragraphs: I'm Murilo Araujo, but everyone in the community calls me Ghst. I started coding in 2019, writing Lua scripts for FiveM roleplay servers, and never stopped.

In-game interfaces led me to React and TypeScript. Servers led me to the back end and infrastructure. Today I work full-stack: I design the system, build the interface, write the API and take care of where it all runs.

Oh, and I hold a law degree. I studied statutes, articles and case law, but bugs, deploys and servers are where I feel at home. I traded the law codes for VS Code and have no regrets. Law didn't become my career, but it gave me a sharper eye for life.

education.title: Bachelor of Laws
education.text: Graduated in one field, fulfilled in another.

journey.title: Every stage, a level up
journey.intro: From Lua scripts on a roleplay server to leading tech for server groups. Here's the road so far.

start.title: First spawn
start.text: I started writing Lua scripts for roleplay servers. It became work: freelance gigs and consulting, building systems, interfaces and integrations that run in production, with real players using them.

growth.title: From NUIs to the web
growth.role: Front end, back end and infra
growth.text: In-game interfaces pulled me into React and TypeScript. Then came APIs with Node.js and NestJS, databases, Docker and deployment. FiveM was my gateway to full-stack.

store.title: My own store
store.text: I built and run my own platform for selling FiveM scripts: catalog, automatic licenses, protected downloads, customer dashboard and Discord integration. A product from scratch to after-sales.

leste.title: Technical leadership
leste.text: I led technology for the Fronteira Leste server group and was the sole developer of Lado Leste: architecture, systems, interfaces and day-to-day server operations.

wins.title: Current quest
wins.text: I work on every server in WinsVue's portfolio, one of the largest companies in the FiveM ecosystem: I build systems, interfaces and integrations and keep the servers running and evolving.

ghst-store.title: Ghst.store
ghst-store.summary: Platform for selling, delivering and managing FiveM scripts, with automatic licenses and a customer dashboard.
features: Script catalog with a page for each product
Automatic licenses with IP control and reset
Customer dashboard: download, copy license, change nickname

admin-panel.title: Admin Dashboard
admin-panel.summary: Real-time web dashboard to manage players, bans, logs and server settings.
features: Live config changes without restarting resources

hud-framework.title: HUD Framework
hud-framework.summary: Modular FiveM HUD: status, map, inventory and notifications, lightweight and easy to customize.
features: Configurable status: health, hunger, thirst, stress
Lua API for other resources to use the HUD
